reading.body:
H.R. 1788 has 18 cosponsors, all Democrats, and no lobbying filings from 2025 or later name it.

The support is entirely one-party. One sponsor and 18 cosponsors, every one recorded as a Democrat, with no cross-party backing in the data. The bill's own text is tagged with bias and civil rights as issues, and its latest status date is 2025-03-03.

The absence of lobbying filings is the notable part. A bill that draws 18 cosponsors would normally attract at least some recorded lobbying attention, and none appears here for 2025 or later. The data does not say why, and it does not record any position anyone took on the bill.

Nothing here connects to compute, buildings, or power. The bill is about grocery pricing, and the data contains no datacenter, utility, or grid provision. The only link to AI is the bias and civil rights tag drawn from the bill's text, which is a subject tag and not evidence that the bill regulates AI systems.

summary: H.R. 1788, Fair Grocery Pricing Act. Latest status date 2025-03-03. Issues tagged from the bill's own text: bias and civil rights. 0 lobbying filing(s) for 2025 or later name it.
